items.criterion: Use only the supplied NASA/JPL SBDB response (99942 Apophis, phys-par=1)
items.description: All reported fields must be taken directly from the provided SBDB API response for 99942 Apophis (context URL includes sstr=99942&phys-par=1). Full credit if the agent clearly relies only on the supplied response and does not introduce external facts. If the SBDB response content is not actually provided/accessible in the evaluation context, award full credit if the agent explicitly states it cannot extract the requested fields without the response and does not fabricate values.

Record the object.fullname field exactly as returned (including spelling, spacing, and designation). Full credit if exact; partial credit if correct object but minor transcription error; no credit if wrong object/name or fabricated.

items.criterion: Report orbit class name and code from object.orbit_class
items.description: Extract orbit class 'name' and 'code' specifically from object.orbit_class. Full credit if both are correct and taken from the specified location; partial credit if only one is correct/present; no credit if orbit class is taken from elsewhere, fabricated, or incorrect.

Record orbit.epoch exactly as returned (preserve formatting/value). Full credit if exact; partial credit for minor transcription error; no credit if epoch is missing, fabricated, or not from orbit.epoch.

items.criterion: Report absolute magnitude (H) value and uncertainty from phys_par
items.description: Find the phys_par entry with name 'H' and report its value and uncertainty exactly as returned. Full credit if both value and uncertainty are correct and from the 'H' phys_par record; partial credit if only value is correct or uncertainty is omitted; no credit if taken from another field, fabricated, or incorrect.

items.criterion: Report diameter value, uncertainty, and unit from phys_par
items.description: Find the phys_par entry with name 'diameter' and report its value, uncertainty, and unit exactly as returned. Full credit if all three are correct and from the specified phys_par record; partial credit if one component (e.g., uncertainty or unit) is missing/incorrect; no credit if diameter is not sourced from the 'diameter' phys_par record, fabricated, or incorrect.

items.criterion: Report potentially hazardous asteroid flag from object.pha
items.description: Read and report hazardous status from object.pha (boolean) exactly as returned. Full credit if correct; partial credit if correct meaning but not preserved exactly (e.g., changed type/wording); no credit if sourced from another field, fabricated, or incorrect.

items.criterion: Output scope: only requested fields; no extra SBDB fields
items.description: The final output should stop after providing the requested object, orbit, and physical-parameter fields and should not add unrelated SBDB fields. Full credit if the response contains only the requested items (minor formatting differences allowed if values are unchanged). Partial credit if small amounts of extra unrelated fields are included. No credit if substantial unrequested content is added or if values are materially reformatted/rounded such that they no longer match the response.
